name: waddling
description: Govern your agents' lakehouse access: dynamic ACLs, instant revoke, full audit trail.
long_description: Connect analytics agents to DuckLake endpoints with per-agent column, row, and time-window ACL rules enforced at the gateway. Revoke any agent instantly. Every query audited. No API key required at install — guided onboarding on first use.

waddling_url.title: DuckBase URL
waddling_url.description: DuckBase control-plane URL. Leave at default unless self-hosting.

telemetry_opt_out.title: Disable telemetry
telemetry_opt_out.description: Set to '0' to opt out of anonymous usage telemetry. SQL, API keys, JWTs, and email addresses are never captured regardless of this setting.
